open_assumptions: Launch nodes (kind worker) link result_uri to the worker's latest worker-phase verification result once its packet exists (same URI as the verify node); their status still only means a session launched.
Candidate-phase packets are exposed as results under node IDs candidate_ui/candidate_adapter; the candidate graph node itself has result_uri null because it has two packets.
Events are read from events.jsonl when present (export copy is the fallback); a run's updated_at is the later of the export updated_at and the newest persisted event time.

A malformed run-state.json in any run directory makes that workflow's run list a 500 RUN_STORAGE_INVALID naming the directory basename, rather than silently skipping it; directories with only plan.json are skipped from lists with a server-log warning and are 404 RUN_UNSUPPORTED on direct access.

Blocked verification packets are served as WorkerResult status failed with error code VERIFICATION_BLOCKED (the producer stores result.status succeeded with the gate separately); blank open_assumptions strings are dropped to satisfy the contract.
Fastify maxParamLength was raised to 256 and a frameworkErrors handler added app-wide; legacy routes keep Fastify's default router-error body and all existing tests still pass.
A configured runs_root is not required to exist at startup; an unusable root is 503 RUNS_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE per request, never an empty list.
Unattributed raw events (unknown node alias) are emitted as type log with node_id and status null rather than inventing a graph node.
result.summary: Implemented the project registry and read-only project/workflow/run API on the existing Fastify server. New: server/projectsConfig.ts (MD_MANAGER_PROJECTS_CONFIG loader in the README shape; unset = empty registry, explicit invalid file fails startup; ID/path/overlap/graph validation; canonical-JSON SHA-256 definition revisions verified byte-equal to Python json.dumps), server/projects.ts (run discovery under configured runs_root only, no-follow bounded reads of run-state.json/plan.json/events.jsonl/packets, hash-verified packet registry, state projection with task-error > interrupt > confirmed evidence > event precedence, paused on contradictions, succeeded only when integrated with nothing pending, worker-result and artifact projection with scoped URLs and path redaction), server/projectRoutes.ts (all seven contract routes under /api/projects, {error:{code,message}} shape, 400/404/405/5xx semantics, keyset cursors, response validation against the committed schemas, safe artifact content types with nosniff/CSP sandbox), config/projects.example.json, server/projects.test.ts (22 tests on disposable roots). Modified: server/app.ts (optional createApp projects/runStore options, plugin registration, maxParamLength 256 and frameworkErrors shaping), server/index.ts (registry loading at startup). Checks actually executed in this worktree after npm ci: backend-unit (npx --no-install tsx --test server/projects.test.ts: 22/22 pass), backend-regression (npm run test:unit: 130/130 pass), shared-contract (npm run test:contracts: 10/10 pass), backend-build (npm run build: exit 0), plus eslint on changed files (clean) and a manual startup smoke test of server/index.ts with invalid, missing, valid and unset registry files. No commits, pushes, agent launches or edits outside server/ and config/projects.example.json.
